author: Bunnyhat
body:
Statues effects like this one really ruins the game for me. For some bosses it's ok, you can equip equipment to deal with it. But then every other raid boss can deal 6 or 7 different effects and you can't gear for all of them. So you have to choose, do I want to deal with curse the entire fight eating 10% of my health every turn, or blight/petrify/stun/frozen/rot/defense down/half a dozen others. Sure, you can use a panacea if you have any, but you'll just be using it again in a couple turns.

And sure, there's some accessories you can use, but the good ones are gated behind these limited raid bosses that you weren't around for, so fuck you.
